ratings_why.fun: Age grows in a line and the payoffs read Age, so stats bend upward late: a real weak-then-devastating curve, and the Relay gives a decision every turn.
ratings_why.distinct: Movable Age and oldest/youngest targeting are fresh, but 'leave it in place and it grows' sits close to Hedgerow folk's turns-in-slot clocks.

verdict_why: Every tier does its job and the v2 loops are capped; what's left is heat for the owner to balance, not a fix.

points.text: The Long Sleep has almost no decisions after turn 6. One card that asks you to choose each turn (spend Age now or keep it for a threshold) would give it a pulse.

Parkelj the Dark only gives movers what Still already gives sleepers, which is thin for a Tier 5 direction card. A payoff for moved units, such as gaining stats per Age on arrival, would make it name a build.
The Robber-Knight hits every enemy, so on an aged board it can clear a turn-12 board at Start of Combat. Worth showing the owner one late-game number with Hrošč beside it.
Beehive Painter's X tracks the oldest unit, so by the late game it gives 15+ stats a turn at Tier 4, above its own 12-stat note. Fine hot, but the tier note should say so.
Dormouse Pilgrim's early Age has only the Hatchling to read it on turns 1-3. Letting it feed the Hatchling or the Novice more directly would soften the rounds 3-6 health loss.

standouts.why: Brother Netopir turns slot placement into Age routing, and makes a fresh Eldest the strongest play.
Mother Ribica makes a few Awaken cards recur, with a clear once-a-turn cap.
Beehive Painter links oldest and youngest, so the targeting system pays off.

weakest.why: Parkelj the Dark is mostly a 6/6 that keeps Age flowing while you move; little payoff of its own.
Dormouse Pilgrim's Age has few readers early, so it is mostly a 2/3.

flags.note: The Robber-Knight's damage to every enemy grows with Age, and opponents can't touch Age; with Hrošč it can wipe boards before attacks.
Dragon of the Springs reads all Age on the board; with Hrošč it can reach well over 100 stats in a fight.
Golden Beehive Painter with golden Hrošč gives six times the oldest's Age each turn to one unit.
Golden Eldest's Awaken triples the whole board once; a high roll worth the owner's eye, not a loop.
